text:
Nina (Partnerships): Claire from BoltLabs just flagged a stuck PO batch: PO-BOLT-991 thru PO-BOLT-996 not moving to 'vendor-ack'. Partner says their EDI system returned HTTP 422 with 'unsupported item code' after our SKU canonicalization change.
Omar - Marketplace Ops: I see the batch: our canonicalizer mapping updated yesterday to normalize legacy bolt skus (strip prefixes). Looks like BoltLabs still sends old prefixed SKUs in EDI 850s. 422 thrown by validation service.
Becky (Deal Desk): Those orders include warranty SKUs and pre-prod GPU units for the partner pilot. The pilot go-live is next week — if fulfillment delays, customer demo and co-marketing launch slip. We need a quick workaround to accept the legacy prefixed SKUs for this partner only.
Vikram (Legal): Note that changing mapping per partner may have tax/ledger implications if it affects SKU accounting. We should keep a clear audit trail and limit scope.
Claire - Hardware Partner (BoltLabs): We can resend corrected EDI files but it will take them a day. Can you accept them as-is for the pilot? We can't change our ERP mapping until next week.
ops-bot: validation-service v3.7 rolled at 2025-01-08T14:03:02Z by pipeline #9004
Omar - Marketplace Ops: Quick option: add partner-scoped accept list in validation-service to map legacy prefixes for boltlabs:partner_id=bolt-908. Low-risk toggle. I'll open a PR and gate it behind a flag.
Becky (Deal Desk): Please do. Also need confirmation we'll not impact billing codes on our side. Finance, can you chime in?
Nina (Partnerships): Tagging @Finance. This is urgent for the joint launch. We need a rollback plan too in case mapping causes downstream mismatch in ledgers.
Becky (Deal Desk): Also, any contract/PO terms we need to confirm? If we accept legacy SKUs, does it change the PO line item definitions?
Vikram (Legal): Short answer: no change to the PO if the canonical SKU resolves to the same product id in ledger. But record the accepted-legacy-sku as a reconciliation note on the PO. I'll add a clause in the partner acceptance memo.
Claire - Hardware Partner (BoltLabs): We're ok with reconciliation notes — we'll include a mapping manifest when we resend. Can your team enable the temporary mapping today?
Omar - Marketplace Ops: PR opened: github.com/redwood/validation-service/pull/1128. Deploy to staging now, will run a canary for partner bolt-908, then flip to prod if green.
ops-bot: canary deploy started at 2025-01-08T14:27:10Z scope=bolt-908
Omar - Marketplace Ops: Canary looks good, no billing delta in staging. Flipping to prod for scoped mapping now.
Becky (Deal Desk): Received prod ack for PO-BOLT-991 after mapping change — status moved to vendor-ack. :partyparrot:
Nina (Partnerships): Great. Claire, please still resend corrected EDI files as backup. We'll keep the scoped mapping for 48h then revert. Document this in the partner launch runbook.
Vikram (Legal): I'll add the reconciliation note template and retention instructions. Also logging: capture incoming raw EDI payloads for these POs for 30 days.
Claire - Hardware Partner (BoltLabs): Thanks team, really appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll send the corrected files tonight and the mapping manifest in the morning.
Becky (Deal Desk): Marking these POs as "launch-exception" and adding internal note. Finance, monitor settlements and ledger entries for any discrepancies.
Omar - Marketplace Ops: Feature flag auto-rollback set for 48h. Alerting channel pinned. ops-bot: prod deploy v3.7.1 completed at 2025-01-08T14:46:31Z
Nina (Partnerships): Excellent cross-team. Learned: add legacy SKU mapping step to onboarding checklist for hardware partners.
Becky (Deal Desk): Agreed. Also capture a post-mortem with partner ops to avoid repeat.
ops-bot: ticket created: #PL-5502 partner-sku-canonicalization-postmortem
Nina (Partnerships): Closing loop unless issues reported. Thanks everyone.
